name: Inventory UI follow-up - prepared manual fixture

steps._note: Disposable save only. After opening Tab for the first time, move rapidly over backpack slots: no lingering borders. Move stacks to/from toolbelt. Inspect trader/reward grids: larger proportional slots, reserved scrollbar, aligned six header icons, padded shortcuts. Reward grid shows five rows. Close every menu, toggle minimap with configured PadEnter twice. Open job cards and switch tiers, then inspect errors for UnloadAsset. Runtime timing remains a manual observation.
